description: Locale configuration file for the Tamil language in Moment.js, defining date and time formats, calendar labels, relative time expressions, and number/money representations specific to Tamil.

methods.name: preparse
methods.description: Converts Tamil digits to Western digits for parsing.

methods.name: postformat
methods.description: Converts Western digits to Tamil digits for formatting.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Determines Tamil meridiem string based on hour.

methods.name: meridiemHour
methods.description: Converts Tamil meridiem string and hour to 24-hour format.

methods.name: ordinal
methods.description: Returns Tamil ordinal suffix for a given number.
